source for

  • CURIE: gmeow:sourceFor
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sourceFor
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/narrative

Relates a creative work (a BookRelease, SerialInstallment, film, game, or other out-of-universe artifact) to the narrative reference frame it contributes to, witnesses, revises, or serves as a source for. Non-functional: a work may source several frames, and a frame may have many sources. The specific role (source, witness, revision, adaptation) is carried by gmeow:accordingTo on the claim or by a reified relator when needed.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CreativeWork -> gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame Sub-property of: gmeow:contributesToFrame

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:sourceFor from gmeow:CreativeWork to gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:contributesToFrame, gmeow:CreativeWork, gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame
